title: Dispense PCR Master Mix in PCR Plates
author: REM Analytics
materials: Pause: check the plate/master mix are in place.
Pause until ready to prepare the following plate.

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the required settings before running the dispense: select Master Mix Source (single reservoir for the whole plate or individual reservoir per row), set the Number of Plates to prepare, choose the Starting Trough (the first free trough to receive the mix), specify the Volume to dispense per well (typically 9 µL without DNA or 10 µL with DNA), and indicate the Touch‑Tip side (the side opposite to where DNA was added, if applicable). Ensure the Number of Plates does not exceed the number of available troughs; otherwise use a new reservoir plate.

steps.title: Verify plate and mix placement
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol and confirm that the PCR plate and the master‑mix source (reservoir or trough) are correctly positioned on the deck.

steps.title: Transfer master mix to plate
steps.instruction: Pick up a fresh tip, then dispense the programmed volume of master mix into every column of the PCR plate located in slot 5, using the specified Touch‑Tip side.

steps.title: Discard used tips
steps.instruction: Drop the used tip(s) into the waste bin.

steps.title: Pause before next plate
steps.instruction: Pause the protocol until you are ready to prepare the next plate (the system will indicate which trough to use for the following plate).
